regulator: Marinha do Brasil — Capitania dos Portos do Rio de Janeiro (Delegacia de Cabo Frio) for vessel certification/crewing; ANTAQ for scheduled waterway passenger services; FIPAC (Fundação Instituto de Pesca de Arraial do Cabo, municipal) for the Marina dos Pescadores tour fleet (Resolução 32/2025, mandatory registration); ICMBio for the Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Arraial do Cabo; Marinha/IEAPM for Ilha do Cabo Frio / Praia do Farol access (Portaria 46/2017, 300 concurrent visitors).
annual_basis_note: FX: 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15). No regulated annual waterborne-passenger series exists for this market: the boat-tour economy is informal/municipally regulated (FIPAC registration only — counts not published), and there is no ANTAQ-scheduled route. Visitor figures above are municipal tourism estimates, not audited passenger counts; the only official waterborne pax counts found are Búzios cruise-tender figures (Prefeitura de Búzios). Per payload, economics remain DISPLAY-ONLY — no official pax series discovered that would change that.
gaps: No official annual passenger series for boat tours in any of the three towns — FIPAC does not publish registered-vessel or passenger counts
